source: Actual integrated-browser CDP screencast frames, timestamped within each capture chunk
suffix_policy: Concatenate sceneN, sceneNb, sceneNc in filename order; remove idle gaps between recordings; preserve every within-chunk frame in capture-timestamp order
timestamp_normalization: Sort each chunk by its original CDP timestamp. In scene6, 00002.jpg was captured 34 milliseconds before 00001.jpg but delivered afterward; both actual frames are retained in capture order.

claims: Actual local prototype; historical photograph and programmed controls; no environmental diagnosis, current incident, human field review or AWS execution claim
